name: sum_derivRootWeight_pos
statement: 0 < degree P) (z : ℂ) : 0 < ∑ w ∈ P.roots.toFinset, derivRootWeight P z w

have_tree.name: hP₀
have_tree.body: by rintro rfl; simp at hP

name: eq_centerMass_of_eval_derivative_eq_zero
statement: 0 < P.degree) (hz : P.derivative.eval z = 0) : z = P.roots.toFinset.centerMass (P.derivRootWeight z) id
